4.30pm. to keep in touch with our offers and to see pictures of our stock don’t forget our facebook page @oldandnewatno5tours of st peter’s cathedral join us for the inaugural féile tours of st peter’s cathedral in belfast as we celebrate its 160th anniversary!tour dates:•monday 3 august at 3pm•tuesday 4 august at 3pm•wednesday 5 august at 3pm•thursday 6 august at 3pmtickets: £5 per person, payable at the entrance (please bring the exact amount). come and discover the history, heritage, and stories of one of belfast’s most treasured landmarks.lough derg the three day pilgrimage season is underway right now and ends on 15th august (13th august is the ﬁnal day for pilgrims to begin the three day pilgrimage). pre-booking is advised - you can book online or ﬁnd out more information on loughderg.orgplenary indulgence the church grants a plenary indulgence in honour of our lady and st francis to those who visit a parish church this weekend. this is known as the indulgence of the portiuncula. it is granted on the usual conditions: •that we reject sin•that we go to holy communion.•that we go to confession (any time three weeks either side of today is permitted).•that we pray for the pope’s intentions (an our father and hail mary would be sufﬁcient).parish of ballymoney& derrykeighancauseway family of parishes2nd august 2026 eighteenth sunday of ordinary timefed by his hand in today's gospel, jesus feeds ﬁve thousand from just ﬁve loaves and two ﬁsh - one of the great miracles, and a sign of his boundless love. as isaiah promises in the ﬁrst reading, god looks after those who are hungry, offering "good things to eat and rich food to enjoy." st paul, in the second reading, is unshakeable in his conﬁdence that nothing - not hardship, not fear, not anything in creation - can separate us from the love of god in christ.this miracle points beyond itself to something greater still: the holy eucharist, where jesus feeds us with his own body and blood. whatever we're carrying this week, we can trust that god cares for us body and soul, and that even greater joy awaits us in the kingdom of heaven.

54.hymns for mass christ be beside me, christ be before me, christ be behind me, king of my heart. christ be within me, christ be below me, christ be above me, never to part. christ on my right hand, christ on my left hand, christ all around me, shield in the strife. christ in my sleeping, christ in my sitting, christ in my rising, light of my life. christ be in all hearts thinking about me, christ be on all tongues telling of me. christ be the vision in eyes that see me, in ears that hear me, christ ever be.praise, my soul, the king of heaven; to his feet thy tribute bring. ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven, who like me his praise should sing? praise him, praise him, praise him, praise him, praise the everlasting king.praise him for his grace and favour to our fathers in distress. praise him still the same forever, slow to chide, and swift to bless. praise him, praise him, praise him, praise him, glorious in his faithfulness.
